facts.fact: President Dharam Gokhool recalls that 'on 26 May 2025, while launching the Blueprint on Digital transformation' he called the launch of the Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029 a defining moment and a 'bold expression of our national resolve'; no adopting act or other body is named.
The speech, dated 29 October 2025, refers to the Blueprint 2025-2029 as outlining 'a bold, inclusive roadmap for integrating AI into our development agenda'.

systems.system: Government Programme - A Bridge to the Future
systems.tiers: presented to the nation on 24 January 2025

note: Passages only. Standing is the President's own account of launching the Blueprint; scope is described only as national resolve and a development roadmap.
